title: Measuring Algorithmic Partisanship via Zero-Shot Classification and Its Implications on Political Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot classification and fine-tuned machine learning models are used to evaluate large language model responses to 300 geopolitical prompts. The methodology computes a composite bias score based on four metrics: partisanship magnitude (mapped on a 2D political compass of left-right and libertarian-authoritarian polarities), response sentiment, topicality, and objectivity.
